All existing `where` tests pass.

**Fix:** In `xarray/core/computation.py:1832`, the `keep_attrs` lambda blindly accessed `attrs[1]`, which fails when the second argument (`x`) is a scalar (scalars have no attrs, so the attrs list is shorter than expected). Changed it to `attrs[1] if len(attrs) > 1 else {}` so it gracefully returns an empty dict when the scalar argument has no attrs entry.
